item.title: Simple Sprout Shop Logo

turns.text: Make a square logo for my plant shop, Little Sprout. Just a simple green sprout above the name on white, nothing fancy.

item.tests: Produces a usable simple logo combining a clear mark and a readable business name.

answer_sheet.Mark and style: A simple green sprout above the name; clean and unfussy.

must_haves: A recognizable, simple green sprout sits above the name.
The square image contains a flat logo, not a photograph or merchandise mockup.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Design a clean botanical logo symbol for a plant shop. A distinctive sprouting plant with two elegant leaves integrated into a simple rounded terracotta pot, subtle circular silhouette, balanced geometric shapes and organic curves. Deep forest green and warm terracotta on a plain ivory background. Flat vector-style graphic, crisp solid fills, minimal detail, strong recognizable silhouette, readable at small sizes. Center a single compact emblem with generous negative space within the wide canvas. Professional brand identity design, friendly and welcoming. Symbol only: no text, letters, words, typography, watermark, mockup, gradients or shadows.
